entries.zh: 聚集多人（使众人一同做某事）；同
entries.en: to gather many people (so that they act together); together
entries.notes: L 末词疑残；H「同」为唯一确证，M 四音节不可分解，义取「聚众同做」。

entries.zh: 搭（与人搭伙）；凑在一起同做某事
entries.en: to join up with others (to do something); to team up
entries.notes: H「搭」与 L「juntarse para hacer algo」相合，M「tāng lōng」对应不完全，取合伙共事义。

entries.en: to stick together, to paste, to glue
entries.notes: H [疑:棕/粘] 取「粘」，M 末音 [残]，义依 L「pegar」定为黏合。

entries.en: together; all together; gathered
entries.notes: H 栏空，依 L「junto」及 M 三音节（疑「總攏總」）定为「一并」。

entries.en: to join, to fit two things together
to compile, to gather from many places

entries.zh: 合掌；双手相合（行礼、祈祷）
entries.en: to join the hands (in prayer or salute)
entries.notes: H [疑:上/手]，L「juntar las manos」与 M「chiŏ」同指「合掌」。

entries.zh: 虾干；把虾聚拢焙晒成干
entries.en: dried shrimp; to gather shrimps (for drying)
entries.notes: L「en la sandez」疑为「en la sartén」（锅中焙虾），H「蝦乾」义明。

entries.en: to assemble, to meet together

entries.zh: 会众；聚集众人（相约会合）
entries.en: to gather a crowd; an assembly of many

entries.zh: 血聚心（血郁结于心口的症候）
entries.en: blood gathering at the heart (a medical condition)
entries.notes: H「血抱心」为旧医症候语，M hūe 即「血」白读，† 或为待考条目之标记。

entries.en: 〔text defective; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: L 为参见注记（另见他处 juntar 诸条），H、M 皆空，R 栏仅存「干」字。

entries.en: 〔text defective; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: H 空、L 残（mas mal…malo 不成句），M「nā giāy」重叠疑表「愈…愈…」，无法定夺。

entries.en: together; alike; the same
entries.notes: H [疑:正/平]，M pêng 指向「平/並」，L 为 juntamente 之副词条。

entries.en: all together; all

entries.zh: 兼；一并兼具（并及前述者）
entries.en: together with; concurrently; both
entries.notes: L 末「dho」为「dicho」（前述）之缩写展开，句尾残。

entries.en: come together with me
let them all come; come along together
all together; everyone
to be together; to join company; to do together

entries.zh: 聚在一起；结伴（用字待考）
entries.en: to gather; to keep company
entries.notes: H [疑:飽/跑] 皆不合 L「hacer junta」，M 末音 pū 待考，与上条「做夥」疑为重出。

entries.en: to swear an oath; to curse by oath
entries.notes: R 栏作「Roberz.」，疑为旁注人名而非对音。

entries.en: to swear, to take an oath
entries.notes: H 栏空，M 单音节 gīn 未能对应，义依 L「Jurar」。

entries.en: 〔text defective; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: L、H 皆空，M 四音节无词头可系，疑为下条窜入或栏外残文。
